$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Instruction content is immutable for one instructionId

rejection.rule: For one instructionId, kind, text, and addressee are immutable. Changing any of them requires a new ID. Only freshness may change. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6.2)
rejection.effect: The phone rejects the snapshot and retains the prior valid Instruction and revision. A new Instruction identity is required to change wording.

summary: A valid coaching Instruction is followed by a later snapshot that reuses the same instructionId but changes the text. The phone MUST reject the second snapshot; renderer state cannot silently reinterpret an action.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: Valid coaching snapshot with Instruction 66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666, text 'move one step to your left'.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your RIGHT.

steps.note: Same instructionId, changed text. The phone rejects the snapshot; the runtime must have issued a new instructionId for a wording change. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6.2)

outcome: The phone retains revision 1 and the original Instruction. Changing actionable text requires a new Instruction identity.
